strategyReview: The core live edge remains in weekend Hyperliquid funding reversion (70% live, 74% shadow) and selected PC-ratio mean-reversion pockets in BTC/OIL, while Polymarket one-touch live executions are small and uneven. The main bleed is from gold upside one-touch/rich-tail/near-expiry premium fades, which are failing because gold is trending up and the rich YES premium is informed risk pricing. Cross-asset BTC chasing at range highs and raw funding-threshold mining variants are also burning tests. Tonight shifts gold premium signals from fade to trend-confirmation, tightens CBRS weekend context, and avoids near-duplicate one-touch threshold variants.

failureClusters.evidence: H-534 0/20, H-532 0/19, find_0036 0/18, and gold_pm_premium family 3/22; gold repeatedly rose 0.2-7.4% through what the model called overpriced upside/tail YES premiums.
failureClusters.recommendation: Stop shorting gold premium/spot on cap-edge, no-bias gap, or near-expiry edge alone. Either retire the fade or invert it to trend-following long with uptrend confirmation.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion family is 30% winners; repeated -2.9%/-3.5% BTC moves after entering when above the 24h SMA and near the 7d high with HYPE risk-on.
failureClusters.recommendation: Add reset/pullback entry conditions instead of chasing strength; HYPE risk-on is not a standalone trend-confirmation edge.

failureClusters.evidence: CBRS H-539 is 46% winners under cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10; funding oscillated -13.7 to +5.5 to -67 to +2.3 to -13.4, showing ordinary weekday noise rather than weekend reversion.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require true weekend sessions plus extreme bottom-decile funding before retesting the weekend reversion family.

failureClusters.evidence: Recent BTC/ETH one-touch NO losses clustered at yesAsk ~0.02-0.08 with compressed edges and an ETH stop of -53.66%; base one-touch shadows average -0.82%.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep edge minima, spread and liquidity gates; do not promote low-premium compressed contracts.

newHypotheses.description: From FIND-0020: smart wallets buying dip-YES on below-strike one-touch contracts predicts underlying recovery. Enter long when the touch-low side shows smart flow long YES.
newHypotheses.prediction: Underlying spot/perp rises >2% within 3 days as smart-money dip buying resolves upward.

newHypotheses.description: From FIND-0043: narrow BTC one-touch NO premium fade to liquid tight-spread above-strike contracts with moderate sell-YES edge. This removes wide-spread/illiquid executions that have dragged the base one-touch shadows.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES on BTC upside one-touch NO contracts with 3-8 pts edge in liquid/tight markets produces positive premium decay within 3 days.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: restrict CBRS funding reversion to true weekend sessions and require an extreme bottom-decile reading rather than any -10% weekday dip. This directly addresses the failure mechanism that raw threshold captured noisy weekday funding oscillations.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS funding normalizes upward and CBRS spot/perp gains >2% within 3 days from a true weekend extreme.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-108: replace late-chasing entry with a reset entry. Buy BTC only when it has pulled back into the lower 40% of its 7d range and is not extended above the 24h SMA, while HYPE risk appetite remains intact.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot/perp rebounds >2% within 3 days as HYPE risk-on confirmation persists through a BTC reset.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-534: flip the contrarian short into a trend-following long. High gold upside one-touch cap-edge has repeatedly marked follow-through buying, not an overpriced fade; require spot above its 24h SMA to stay with the trend.
newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot/perp rises >2% within 3 days when rich upside one-touch NO premium coincides with an uptrend.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-567: do not sell GOLD near-expiry upside NO premium when edge appears; treat that edge as a trend signal and go long underlying when GOLD is above its 24h SMA. This reverses the failed premium-decay mechanism.
newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot/perp rises >2% within 3 days as near-expiry upside NO edge marks informed bullish demand.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The mined variant took any cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10 reading as a reversion trigger; test outcomes show noisy oscillation: -13.7 to +5.5 win, +5.5 to -67 loss, -67 to +2.3 win, +2.3 to +1.3 loss, +1.3 to +2.3 win, +2.3 to -13.4 loss. Raw threshold without weekend or recovery confirmation selected high-noise entries.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and forces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The condition set buys BTC already above the 24h SMA, within 4% of the 7d high, and HYPE above its SMA with stable OI; recent tests are 7/23 and show repeated 2-3.5% BTC drops after entry, with a single 9.66% win masking mostly chasing losses.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE risk-on participation confirms durable BTC momentum rather than marking late-stage FOMO/overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The low gold put/call ratio and elevated PM settlement EV did not produce the expected 7-day spot edge; the family is 3/22 and gold kept grinding higher through fade attempts. The condition set marked persistent bullish positioning, not a reversal setup.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Gold P/C ratio collapse below 0.65 with PM settlement EV above spot predicts a sustainable spot rally toward PM levels within 7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 0/20 scorable tests. Gold cap-edge >= 10 was followed by gold rallying rather than the predicted >2% decline; spot often rose 0.2-5.4% over the test window, so the edge was a by-product of strong upside demand, not overpriced NO premium to fade.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 0/19 scorable tests. The rich tail no-bias gap threshold >= 12.3 also failed as gold rallied through the fade window, including 4380 to 4510 and 4519 to 4623. The gap is trend strength, not a mean-reversion sell signal.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large no-bias adjusted gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 0/18 scorable tests. Near-expiry GOLD upside one-touch NO edge did not decay safely; gold rallies of 0.7-7.4% repeatedly hit or threatened the upside barriers, showing the YES premium was informed directional pricing rather than stale overpricing.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Positive sell-YES edge on near-expiry GOLD upside one-touch contracts indicates overpriced premium that will mature OTM, rather than a directional risk premium for a gold uptrend.

journalEntry: No parameter changes tonight: the dominant problems are condition/mechanism mismatches rather than risk sizing. The weekend funding reversion live edge is still the cleanest profit engine, while gold one-touch/tail premium fades are now classified as invalid mean-reversion theses and are being inverted to trend-following refinements. I kept new finding-authored hypotheses to two non-duplicative angles and otherwise focused on refining failing primary variants with materially different mechanisms.
